Disappointing
Aug 2026 • Family
A disappointing experience 
It is true that the pizzas were good, but mine was missing two ingredients and the waiter did not inform us of this shortage.
One of us (there were 8 of us) ordered a salad as an appetizer and the waiter brought the pizza before the appetizer; his argument: the salad was ready before the pizza, we had to argue quite a bit for him to bring the salad first!!!
The waiter advised us to order desserts at the same time as the appetizers and main courses since they didn't have enough; and he was going to set them aside for us; when it came time for dessert, he informed us that 2 out of 4 desserts had been served to other customers by mistake apparently (hard to believe since we got the other 2) and that there were none left.....
I strongly advise against this place and we will not be going back....

Bad experience
Dec 2024 • Family
I visited this restaurant based on many recommendations, but unfortunately, the experience was disappointing. While the food was good, the treatment by the floor supervisor was very poor and completely ruined our experience.

From the moment we entered, there was no genuine welcome; instead, there was a condescending and inappropriate attitude. When we asked for assistance or had any inquiries, the response was cold and uninterested, which made us feel uncomfortable.

Restaurants are not just about food; they’re about a complete experience, including the quality of service. Unfortunately, the service here fell far short of expectations.

Disappointment...
Nov 2024 • Couples
We would like to express our disappointment with our recent experience at your property. The pasta ordered did not meet our expectations: the sauce seemed ill-suited and lacked flavor, giving the impression that it was designed for another dish. My husband had to ask for the addition of the ingredients mentioned on the menu (cherry tomatoes, basil, and seasoning), a step that should have been done from the initial preparation. This led to an uncomfortable situation where I had to start my meal alone while waiting for his dish to be rectified.

 Unfortunately, even after this second attempt, the final result was still not satisfactory. This experience did not meet our expectations and did not live up to what we had hoped.
